verdict.rationale: Fireworks has a public pricing page with self-serve billing (auto reload, monthly spend limits, fine-tuned models at base-model prices). Its docs refer to pay-per-token serverless pricing and define discounts as fractions of 'Serverless per-token prices' (batch at 50% off, cached input at 50% of input), which implies published per-token rates. However, no actual per-token figures appear in the evidence, and nothing confirms every hosted model has a listed price. Missing for 10: concrete per-model per-token price listings, evidence that coverage spans every hosted model, independent confirmation that prices are visible without contacting sales.
